;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[6 March 2020 Kabul shooting]]
***At least 32 people are killed and 81 are injured when gunmen [[mass shooting|attack]] a ceremony in [[Kabul]], Afghanistan. Afghan politician [[Abdullah Abdullah]] was present and escapes unharmed. [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/islamic-state-attacks-kabul-gathering-killing-at-least-32-idUSKBN20T0RO (Reuters)]
*Two [[suicide bomb]]ers on a motorcycle detonate their explosives near the United States [[embassy]] in [[Tunis]], [[Tunisia]], killing a policeman and wounding five others. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/suicide-bombing-near-us-embassy-tunis (''Middle East Eye'')] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 2–3, 2020|United States tornado outbreak of March 2–3, 2020]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] approves a [[Disaster area|disaster declaration]] for all areas affected by the [[tornado]]es. [https://www.wsmv.com/news/president-trump-approves-tennessee-disaster-declaration/article_b8666ad8-5f52-11ea-86b8-87d789a72767.html (WSMV Nashville)]
**The [[National Weather Service]] concludes the [[Enhanced Fujita scale|EF3]] tornado that went through [[Davidson County, Tennessee|Davidson]], [[Wilson County, Tennessee|Wilson]], and [[Smith County, Tennessee|Smith]] counties in [[Tennessee]] was confirmed on the ground for {{convert|60.13|miles|km}}, becoming the second longest path a tornado has taken in Tennessee. [https://www.weather.gov/ohx/20200303 (NWS)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Committee on the Rights of the Child]] of the [[United Nations]] condemns the [[government of the Cook Islands]] for criminalizing [[gay sexual practices|homosexual sex]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/411138/un-committee-grills-cooks-govt-over-same-sex-treatment (RNZ)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Guyanese general election]]
**Police in [[Georgetown, Guyana|Georgetown]], [[Guyana]], surround the nation's election commission after there are accusations that the elections results were altered to help incumbent President [[David A. Granger]] win the election. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guyana-election/guyana-police-surround-elections-council-amid-dispute-over-vote-results-idUSKBN20T23T?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[SpaceX CRS-20]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches a [[SpaceX Dragon|Dragon]] spacecraft in orbit to resupply the International Space Station. This marks the last launch of a Dragon spacecraft, soon to be replaced by [[Dragon 2]], and the 50th successful recovery of a [[Falcon 9]] first stage booster. [https://www.space.com/spacex-launches-cargo-international-space-station.html (Space.com)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on basketball]]
***An [[NCAA Division III men's basketball tournament]] matchup at the [[Johns Hopkins University]] [[2020 NCAA Division III men's basketball tournament|between]] [[Yeshiva Maccabees men's basketball|Yeshiva]] and [[WPI Engineers men's basketball|WPI]] is played without spectators after a student at [[Yeshiva University]] has tested positive for the [[coronavirus]], making it the first U.S. sporting event to do so over coronavirus concerns. [https://apnews.com/general-news-domestic-news-domestic-news-4984cd89670bee1e96114b44a5b033d3 (AP)] [https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28852339/d-iii-game-played-empty-gym-amid-virus-fears (ESPN)]
